description: This is the main entry point for a Jetty-based web server application. It configures and starts an embedded Jetty server, sets up the web application context, and manages server lifecycle including a shutdown hook.

classes.name: EnterpriseApplication
classes.description: Main class that initializes and runs an embedded Jetty server to host a web application.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Program entry point, configures and starts the Jetty server, and adds a shutdown hook.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Fetches a resource URL as a string based on resource name.

methods.name: getResourceFilePath
methods.description: Gets the file system path of a resource URL.

methods.name: resolvePort
methods.description: Resolves server port from system property or defaults to 8090.
